nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Something here is out of line. Give me a second.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The notices are pinned at the same height except one. That one sits higher, and the tape behind it is clean where the old tape was. Someone moved it up to be read.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A board with paper on it. That is all a board is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You read the top two: a room wanted, a piano for sale. The third has been turned face-in. It has not been taken down.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: This yard is longer than it is wide, and the path comes in at the corner.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The concrete has a seam where two pours meet, and the seam runs past the middle of the yard. The gate is set at the short end. Whoever laid the path expected people to arrive somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A yard. Two hoops, a shed, a bench.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is the shape a schoolyard is. You have stood in one before, or in a yard built from the same plan.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Hold on. Look at where that pole stands.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Its pole stands in concrete that is newer than the yard, and the old bolt holes are still in the wall, filled and painted over. This hoop has been moved closer.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The rim is at the height a rim is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You do not know that height. The pole is set in a patch of concrete a different colour from the rest of the yard, and the net is newer than the rim.
